fato_historico: 1894: First Sino-Japanese War: Japan defeats the Qing dynasty in the Battle of Pyongyang, causing the Qing army to withdraw to the Chinese border with Korea.

It is a good time to detach from old conflicts and focus on building your own path forward with wisdom and newfound grace.
frase_do_dia: Strategic patience often turns the tides toward your most brilliant victories.
